name: Gent's Style By Tamara
phone_note: No public phone number found after checking Birdeye, Bizapedia, Facebook, the Square site config, and web search. Left null rather than fabricated.
email_source: Found embedded in the Square Online site's own social/contact config (tamara-camps-llc.square.site), listed as the account's contact email.
booking_platform: Square Online (JS-rendered menu, no prices exposed in static HTML)

rating.source: Birdeye aggregator (reviews.birdeye.com/gent-s-style-by-tamara-170250471032300), which explicitly attributes every individual review to "Google" with real reviewer names and relative dates. Direct Google Maps scraping was attempted twice (WebFetch) but Maps is a JS-rendered SPA and returned no data both times, a known technical limitation. The Birdeye count/rating independently matches the figure known from prior recon (108-109 reviews, 5.0), which corroborates it.
rating.verification_note: Not directly confirmed by rendering Google Maps itself, but corroborated by a reputable third-party aggregator with per-review Google source attribution, real full names, and consistent relative dates. Used the standard testimonials variant (not sin-testimonios) on this basis.

reviews_used.author: Victor Martinez
reviews_used.quote: Excelente servicio y un corte de pelo impecable. Muy profesional, atenta a los detalles y el resultado superó mis expectativas. Sin duda volveré. Totalmente recomendado.

reviews_used.author: Gustavo Ortega
reviews_used.quote: One of the friendliest and most talented hair stylists for men in Miami. Tammy has cut my hair for the last 2 years, and I've loved every cut Tammy has given.

reviews_used.author: Emilio Cordova
reviews_used.quote: Tuve una excelente experiencia en esta barbería. Tamara fue quien me atendió y sinceramente hizo un trabajo increíble. Muy profesional, amigable y atenta en todo momento. Quedé súper feliz con el resultado.

reviews_seen_not_used.author: Eduardo
reviews_seen_not_used.quote: Tamara always gets me right. Clean cuts, good attention to detail, and a chill atmosphere. Definitely recommend.

services_note: No prices found anywhere (Square static HTML is JS-rendered with no exposed prices; Google cache, Yelp and Birdeye did not surface a price list either). Site shows service category NAMES only, no invented numbers. Note: the Square site's internal config also lists theme color-preset names ("Bold", "Custom", "Dark bold", "Duo", "Light Neutral", "Light bold", "Muted bold") which are Square Online THEME names, not sub-styles of the Men's category as initially suspected from prior recon; confirmed by inspecting the site's embedded JSON (color profile objects) and excluded from the service list.

photos.source: Instagram public profile via scripts/ig_photos.py (Railway ig-photo-service, 12 posts captured)

photos.reuse_note: Only 5 distinct real usable photos were available publicly. To fill the skeleton's hero + experience + gallery slots without padding with rejected photos, bk-3/bk-4/bk-7/bk-10 are intentionally reused across sections (different crop/caption each time); no images were fabricated or sourced from stock.

palette.name: Steel blue (acero)
palette.notes: Fresh masculine palette not previously used in the queue (avoids gold/original, and avoids already-used coral/caramelo/esmeralda/teal-acero/violeta-dark/rosa-dark). Merktop badge kept gold (#D4A84B) per protected-badge rule.
